risk_note: RV2 money change (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1; orchestrator ruling D10-456 ④; 拍板第二批 FUND-04): the tax of a withdrawal is computed at application from content's tax.SERVICE_FEE.* configuration (B2-08cz) — none (default, until the rate table arrives) → 0; flat_rate → round_half_up(amount × rate_bp / 10000); cumulative → max(0, due(tax_ytd of the current real-name identity + in-flight PENDING_REVIEW / APPROVED / PAYING of the same +08:00 year + amount) − withheld − in-flight tax) over the configured bracket table; all bigint through @couli/money, never a rate in code, tax_rule_version fixed as a deterministic text of the effective configuration. A missing row is its default, an invalid value is its default with a warn (key only); no verified real name → 0 / 0 with a warn (no hmac). withdraw-apply stores the quote taken again under the users row lock (BR-WDR-07) so a concurrent application counts as in flight; the first-pass quote only serves the pre-lock validation. The estimate endpoint uses the same calculator. No frozen test changed; no contract change; no migration.
